ideas.title: FBI agent's resignation raises questions about investigation into Renee Good's death
ideas.description: The resignation of an FBI agent who sought to investigate the fatal shooting of Renee Good by an ICE officer has raised concerns about the investigation's impartiality.
ideas.angle: Investigating the circumstances surrounding the agent's resignation and its impact on the case
questions: What were the agent's concerns about the investigation?
How will the agent's resignation affect the case?
ideas.insight: This story could explore the potential conflicts of interest in the investigation and the implications of the agent's resignation.
